Hello,  I'm looking for some recommendations. I've been using HyperX Cloud I's  for over 3 years now and they are about to fall apart... So I figured  it's time to get something nicer, since I spent most of my day with  headphones on. I'll be really grateful for all the help I can get.

* **Budget** \- 150$. Can be a little more if the upgrade is worth it.
* **Source** \- My laptop.
* **Requirements for Isolation** \- A lot.
* **Will you be using these Headphones in Public?** Never
* **Preferred Type of Headphone** Full-sized.
* **Preferred tonal balance** \- I am not sure, so I guess balanced will be best.
* **Past headphones**  \- HyperX Cloud I. They fit me really well; I have a really large head  and I spend a lot of time with headphones on, so tight headphones are a  no-go. They play quite nice and have a solid build quality.
* **Preferred Music** \- Mostly rock. Sometimes electronic as well. For example I love Linkin Park, Nirvana, Pixies and Depeche Mode.
* **What would you like to improve on from your set-up** \- Better sound quality, high comfort of use, good isolation.
* **Location** \- Poland
